title: Writing / Tone / Content
slide_intent: Let the human stakes of a story determine its tone so serious experiences receive respect and achievements receive celebration.
strategic_value: Contrasting a refugee story with a learning streak can help Duolingo avoid treating every story as upbeat marketing material.
demonstration: Two stacked scenarios contrast respectful handling of hardship with celebration of a student’s 900-day streak, each with preferred and rejected copy.
practical_value: Match punctuation and emotional intensity to the story rather than applying one cheerful template.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Content title and explanation of the broad subject range at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack the serious story first and the celebratory story below, keeping each instruction with its Like this and Not this comparison.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explicitly says hardship should be treated as a person’s life and explains why different content needs different tone.
reference_purposes.Application: Two complete story comparisons demonstrate changing emotional intensity.
reference_purposes.Constraint: For the serious story, the source directs writers to reduce exuberance and exclamation points.

ingredient.name: Content-sensitive tone
ingredient.role: Respect the emotional weight of the subject.
ingredient.application: Use restraint for hardship and appropriate celebration for achievements.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. The contrasting examples concern editorial stories, not a universal ban on exclamation points.
